payload.text: The one-arm re-run that closes 0.1.26's pre-cut helpers leg (hold 44's, released by vc's go after hv's /compact): helpers.bats's traps_restore arm (0311) alone in pc0126's tree at f18a7a7c, by pc0126/arm0311.sh, in the foreground with no nohup under the bsd gate environment. Light ask 01M7MB5A5CMYBPF5CDKBMR4VSC is with vc with the driver; START on vc's GO, END to vc with the arm's TAP line. Green: vc books the cut. Red with HUP at the default: a code red, and the cut waits.
